BiblicalUsage: Kakosis is affliction — maltreatment, the oppression of a people. God says to Moses, I have seen the affliction of my people which is in Egypt, and I am come down to deliver them.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God sees affliction and comes down: the cry of the oppressed is never unheard, and deliverance begins with His seeing.
